reason: A browser UI utility that sends the current conversation draft to the configured language model for prompt rewriting and provides undo to restore the original text.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框提供基于默认语言模型的一键提示词优化和原文撤销功能。
summaries.en: Provides one-click prompt rewriting in the DeepSeek Harness web composer using the configured default language model, with undo support for restoring the original draft.

capabilities: Sends the current draft to the configured default language model through a host API endpoint
Rewrites the browser conversation draft with the optimization result
Restores the previous draft through an undo action
